operator_external_optics: User reports clean, no protective film
assessment: Optical defocus or internal optical issue suspected, not proven. High resolution and maximum sharpness did not restore details; uncompressed sample also blurred. Short exposure too dark for a conclusive motion-blur comparison.
next_step: Operator place high contrast target about 50cm from head for focal-plane check; no lens disassembly or adjustment performed.

checkerboard_followup.observation: Desktop checkerboard visible in both views, edges remain blurred
checkerboard_followup.status: Standard V4L2 focus unavailable; need camera-specific focus method or physical optical service; not resolved

sources.finding: Official example calls 1bcf:2d4f with serial 01.00.00 Cherry Dual Camera (DECXIN); matching identifiers are a lead, not unique model identification.
Official optional stereo head camera hardware/mounting references; no verified focus procedure for this unit found.
Vendor describes its dual AR0234 USB2 UVC 3840x1200 platform as fixed focus mechanically adjustable by lens rotation. This is a comparable product, not identified as installed hardware.

web_review.conclusion: No verified installed-model software focus command or mechanical adjustment procedure found. Obtain model/label/supplier guidance before any lens adjustment; do not infer AR0234 solely from resolution or DECXIN solely from VID/PID.

post_physical_focus.visual_result: At 640x480, table checkerboard, grippers and background edges markedly clearer than previous samples; stereo high-resolution two-view focus not reverified in this run
